title: Pure Jar
summary: The Jar strategy is a Flip-control and deck-out engine built around resetting the board with Cyber Jar and Morphing Jar while burning through both decks. Prediction Princess Bibliomuse and Tarotrei (or Book of Taiyou and Book of Moon) repeatedly flip your Jars face-up and face-down during either player's turn, triggering Reverse Reuse to plant disruptive Jars onto the opponent's field.

allow.Prediction Princess Tarotrei: Level 9 Ritual boss that flips any Jar monster face-up or face-down as a Quick Effect and revives a Flip monster during every End Phase.
allow.Prediction Princess Bibliomuse: Level 9 Flip monster that revives itself face-down when Tributed and searches both Tarotrei and a Ritual Spell when flipped face-up.
allow.Underworld Ritual of Prediction: Ritual Spell that summons Tarotrei from hand or GY and banishes itself from the GY to summon a Flip monster directly from the Deck.
allow.Prediction Ritual: Ritual Summons Tarotrei and banishes from GY to search a Prediction Princess monster.
allow.Pre-Preparation of Rites: Searches Prediction Princess Tarotrei and Prediction Ritual from your Deck.
allow.Book of Taiyou: Flips a Set Morphing Jar or Cyber Jar into face-up Attack Position on Turn 1 to trigger its Flip effect immediately.
allow.Book of Moon: Flips a face-up Morphing Jar or Cyber Jar back into face-down Defense Position so its Flip effect can be triggered a second time.
allow.Book of Eclipse: Flips all face-up monsters on the field face-down, resetting your Jars while neutralizing opposing boss monsters.
allow.Reverse Reuse: Normal Trap that revives up to 2 Flip monsters from your GY to your opponent's field in face-up or face-down Defense Position.
allow.Subterror Behemoth Fiendess: Link-2 Flip support monster made with two Flip monsters that sends a Jar from Deck to GY to summon a Jar from hand face-down and searches a Flip monster.

main: Morphing Jar
Iconic Flip Rock monster that forces both players to discard their entire hands and draw 5 fresh cards.
Cyber Jar
Flip Rock monster that destroys all monsters on the field, then excavates 5 cards to Special Summon Level 4 or lower monsters.
Morphing Jar #2
Flip Rock monster that shuffles all monsters on the field into the Decks, then both players excavate until they hit the same number of monsters to Special Summon face-down.
Dice Jar
Flip Rock monster that makes both players roll a six-sided die and inflicts up to 6000 burn damage to the loser.
Aroma Jar
Flip Rock monster that cannot be destroyed by battle after being flipped face-up and gains 500 LP during every End Phase.
Absorbing Jar
Flip Rock monster that destroys all Set Spell/Trap Cards on the field and makes each player draw 1 card for every card destroyed.
Dimension Jar
Flip Machine monster that lets both players banish up to 3 monsters from their opponent's GY.
Prediction Princess Tarotrei
Acts as a Quick Effect Book of Taiyou and Book of Moon on legs while reviving Morphing Jar or Cyber Jar from the GY during the End Phase.
Prediction Princess Bibliomuse
Tributes itself for Tarotrei to immediately revive itself face-down, then searches Tarotrei and a Ritual Spell when flipped.
Underworld Ritual of Prediction
Ritual Summons Tarotrei from hand or GY and banishes itself during the Standby Phase to summon Morphing Jar or Cyber Jar face-down from the Deck.
Prediction Ritual
Ritual Summons Tarotrei and banishes from GY to search a Prediction Princess monster.
Pre-Preparation of Rites
Adds Prediction Princess Tarotrei and Prediction Ritual from your Deck to your hand.
Book of Taiyou
Flips a Set Jar monster face-up immediately on the turn you Set it.
Book of Moon
Resets a face-up Morphing Jar or Cyber Jar back to face-down Defense Position to reuse its Flip effect.
Book of Eclipse
Flips the entire board face-down to reset your Jars and turn off opposing negates.
Reverse Reuse
Normal Trap that revives up to 2 Flip monsters from your GY to your opponent's field in face-up or face-down Defense Position.
extra: Link-2 monster that dumps Morphing Jar or Cyber Jar from the Deck to summon a Flip monster from your hand face-down, then searches any Flip monster when a Set monster is flipped face-up.
